items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: Diz? He wasn't a regular, but he would do a week with us; he was in and out.

ctx.x: Was he really a regular or did he just show up at times?
Diz? He wasn't a regular, but he would do a week with us; he was in and out.
Was he a good technical player in those days, in addition to being an extraordinary soloist, but he played in tune and played the book well and cooperated as a section player?
